scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: '1fi-emi-app/backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'preview'], { cwd: '1fi-emi-app/frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: '1fi-emi-app/backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: '1fi-emi-app/frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix 1fi-emi-app/frontend install && npm --prefix 1fi-emi-app/frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('1fi-emi-app/frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('1fi-emi-app/frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('1fi-emi-app/backend/public/images', 'dist/images', { recursive: true });"
